textRuns.value: Incremental revenue & cost savings → EBITDA → less straight-line D&A (investment ÷ horizon) → × (1 − tax) = NOPAT → + D&A − maintenance CapEx − ΔNWC = incremental UFCF (final year recovers the NWC balance).

Then three tests, read together: NPV at the hurdle > 0 · IRR > hurdle · incremental ROIC > WACC. All pass = APPROVE, all fail = REJECT, disagreement = REVIEW — and when the accounting return says yes but the cash tests say no, cash rules.
